meta.title: Free GPX Merger - Combine Multiple GPS Track Files Online
meta.description: Merge multiple GPX files into one. Free, privacy-first online tool to combine GPS tracks, waypoints, and routes. Works entirely in your browser.
meta.keywords: GPX merger, merge GPX files, combine GPS tracks, GPX combiner, join GPX files, merge GPS files, GPX joiner, combine tracks

intro: Combine multiple GPX files into a single file. Merge tracks from different activities, days, or devices into one unified GPS file.
saveIntro: Or skip the download — we'll merge and import it into your Dawarich account during signup.
privacy: Merging happens in your browser. Nothing is uploaded unless you choose “Save to my Dawarich account.”

items.body: Combine multi-day hikes or bike trips into one file
Merge tracks from different GPS devices
Create a complete route from separate segments
Build a comprehensive track for visualization
**Tracks** - All GPS track segments with timestamps and elevation
**Metadata** - Combined into a new merged file description

cards.title: Merge Options Explained
paragraphs: **Keep tracks separate:** Each input file's tracks remain as individual tracks in the output. Good for maintaining activity boundaries.
**Merge into single track:** All track points are combined into one continuous track. Useful for creating a unified route visualization.
